snippet.title: The Moon is our Friend - Endless mode
snippet.description:
The Moon is our Friend is a game for Playdate, where you help protect your best friend (the Earth) from a barrage of meteors.
Get the game on Itch! https://paigeruten.itch.io/moon-is-friend
